test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

The company is planning to __cut back few__ employees.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The phrase "cut back few employees" is incorrect in the context of reducing workforce numbers.

• The correct phrase for reducing workforce numbers is "lay off some," which means to dismiss employees from their job.

• "Cut back" typically refers to reducing or diminishing something, but it does not correctly convey the action of dismissing employees
